sanskrit: sīsāyānv āha varuṇaḥ sīsāyāgnir upāvati | sīsaṃ ma indraḥ prāyacchad amīvāyās tu cātanam ||
english: Varuṇa has spoken in favor of lead; Agni attends upon lead. Indra bestowed lead upon me as a dispeller of disease.

sanskrit: idaṃ viṣkandhaṃ sahata idaṃ bādhate atriṇaḥ | anena viśvā sāsahai yā jātāni piśācyāḥ ||
english: This overpowers viṣkandha; this drives back those who devour. By means of this I shall overpower all things that are born of the piśācī-demon.

sanskrit: ye 'māvāsyāṃ rātrim udasthur bhrājam atriṇaḥ | agnis turīyo yātuhā sa u naḥ pātu tebhyaḥ ||
english: Those who arose at the new-moon night gleaming — the devourers: Agni is the fourth one, the slayer of sorcerers; may he protect us from them.

sanskrit: yadi haṃsy aśvaṃ yadi gāṃ yadi pūruṣam | sīsena vidhyāmas tvā yathā no 'so avīrahā ||
english: Whether you strike a horse, whether a cow, whether a man — we pierce you with lead, so that you shall be devoid of heroes against us.

sanskrit: abhīvartena maṇinā yenendro abhivāvṛte | tenemaṃ brahmaṇaspate abhi rāṣṭrāya vartaya ||
english: With the all-encompassing amulet by which Indra has encompassed himself — with that, O Bṛhaspati, make this one revolve toward the kingdom.

sanskrit: abhivṛttaḥ sapatnā- -abhi yā no arātayaḥ | abhi pṛtanyantaṃ tiṣṭha- -abhi yo no durasyati ||
english: Encompassed are the rivals, encompassed are those who are hostile to us; stand over the one who wars against us, over the one who does harm to us.

sanskrit: abhi tvā devaḥ savitā- -abhi somo avīvṛtat | abhi tvā viśvā bhūtāny abhīvarto yathāsasi ||
english: The god Savitṛ has encompassed you; Soma has encompassed you; all beings have encompassed you, so that you are the all-encompassing one.

sanskrit: ud asau sūryo agād uditaṃ māmakaṃ vacaḥ | yathāhaṃ śatruhāsāny asapatnaḥ sapatnahā ||
english: That sun has risen; risen too is my word: that I shall be a slayer of enemies, without rivals, a killer of rivals.

sanskrit: sapatnakṣayaṇo vṛṣā- -abhirāṣṭro viṣāsahiḥ | yathāham eṣāṃ vīrāṇāṃ virājāni janasya ca ||
english: A bull who annihilates rivals, who overpowers the kingdom, who overcomes all — that I may shine supreme over these heroes and over the people.

sanskrit: tubhyam eva jariman vardhatām ayaṃ mainam anye mṛtyavo hiṃsiṣus tvat | māteva putraṃ pramanā upasthe mitra enaṃ mitryāt pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: May this one grow old unto you alone, O Old Age; let not the other deaths harm him except you. As a mother with full love holds a son in her lap, may Mitra protect him from distress through friendship.

sanskrit: mitraś ca tvā varuṇaś ca riśādau jarāmṛtyuṃ kṛṇutāṃ saṃvidānau | tad agnir hotā vayunāni vidvān viśvāni devo janimā vivakti ||
english: May Mitra and Varuṇa, devouring foes in accord, make for you death-by-old-age. That Agni, the invoking priest, knowing the ordinances, the god who is the generator of all, shall proclaim all things.

sanskrit: dyauṣ ṭe pitā pṛthivī mātā jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ kṛṇutaṃ dīrgham āyuḥ | yathā jīvā adityā upasthe prāṇāpānābhyāṃ gupitaḥ śataṃ himāḥ ||
english: Heaven is your father, Earth is your mother — let them make for you old-age-death and long life, so that you may live a hundred winters in the lap of Aditi, guarded by in-breath and out-breath.

sanskrit: tvam īśiṣe paśūnāṃ pārthivānāṃ ye jātā uta ye janitvāḥ | mainaṃ prāṇo hāsīn mo apāno mainaṃ mitrā vadhiṣur mo amitrāḥ ||
english: You rule over earthly cattle — those already born and those yet to be born. Let not the in-breath abandon him, nor the out-breath; let not friends slay him, nor enemies.
